payload.title: Verify publication identities and approve exact Data Parade activation targets
payload.description: Owner: dataparade-preparation; user domain/editorial criteria expected later today, do not repeatedly ask. Depends on tenant-aware preparation story and Cyclotron owner-grant feature decision-flywheel-e5dcca5a-6438-41ef-b7a9-4f8e8dd56016. Verify actual SaaS organization UUID, meaning of perspective, publication identity and existing resources through normal authenticated metadata readback. Read-only inventory found existing Data Parade product sites and local dataparade-wiki pod, but no new hosted publication established. Data Parade AWS inventory is blocked by expired SSO. Prepare exact repository/app/domain/account/storage/grant/output/billing/retention diff before requesting final activation approval. No production grants, persistent credentials, DNS/infrastructure changes, policies or labels authorized.
